headline: Global Food Prices Fall 1.2% in October as Cereal, Meat, and Dairy Costs Ease
summary: The FAO food price index dropped to 133.9 points in October as cereal, meat, and dairy prices eased, though sugar prices climbed to their highest level since December 2024.
why: Global food price indices reflect international commodity supply and demand trends, influencing agricultural producer revenues and consumer price inflation worldwide.

impacts.name: FAO Food Price Index
impacts.why: The FAO index tracks international market prices of a basket of food commodities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
